# header

The header of the playproject site: title and the parallax scene.

## usage

```js
const STATE = require('STATE')
const statedb = STATE(__filename)
const { get } = statedb(defaults)
const net = require('net_helper')
const header = require('header')

module.exports = page

async function page (opts) {
  const { id, sdb } = await get(opts.sid)
  const { io, _ } = net(id)
  io.on = { header: onmessage_from_header }
  const subs = await sdb.watch(onbatch)
  const sub = subs.find(sub => sub.type.endsWith('>header'))
  const el = await header({ ...sub }, io.invite('header', { app: id }))
  _.header('scroll', {}) // scroll it into view
  return el

  function onbatch (batch) {}
  function onmessage_from_header (msg) { }
}

function defaults () {
  return {
    api,
    _: { net_helper: { $: '' }, header: { $: '' } }
  }
  function api () {
    return {
      _: {
        net_helper: { 0: '' },
        header: { 0: '', mapping: { style: 'style', content: 'content' } }
      },
      drive: { 'style/': {}, 'content/': {} }
    }
  }
}
```

`src/app.js` uses it the same way as the page root.

## invite

Expects one protocol in its invite: `app`, the page that owns the sections.

- receives `scroll`: scroll itself into view

## drive

- `style/header.css`
- `content/header.json`: `{ title }`
